messages:
ava: Hey design team — launching benchmark blog + webinar next month. Need a compact asset kit that marketing can reuse. High level asks below.

noah: list?

ava: TL;DR deliverables: 1) modular benchmark diagram (latency vs cost) with interchangeable data layers; 2) three social tile variants (hero, quote, stat); 3) animated 10s GIF/Lottie for webinar intro; 4) Keynote + Google Slides masters; 5) localized PNGs (en, ja, de).

riley: For the benchmark diagram — do we have canonical data or should design use placeholders?

ava: Use this CSV for the prototype. Keep text layers editable for swapping numbers later.

```
deployment,median_p95_ms,unit_cost_usd
hosted,0.045,0.0008
dedicated,0.028,0.0015
private,0.060,0.0012
```

kate: For social sizes, confirm: LinkedIn feed (1200x627), Twitter card (1200x675), IG square (1080x1080). Also need alt text for each image and copy variants for three personas: platform-engineer, product-lead, startup-founder.

oliver: Copy variants — can you paste tone + CTAs?

ava: Tone: technical but approachable. Examples: platform-engineer: "Optimize inference cost & latency with predictable serving" / CTA: "See the benchmark"; product-lead: "Deliver reliable LLM experiences at scale" / CTA: "Read the case study"; startup-founder: "Smaller cost, faster responses — ship features faster" / CTA: "Try the demo". Keep all CTAs as editable text layers too.

riley: Animation ask — subtle token-level sparkline that grows then fades, plus a pulsing highlight on the recommended configuration. Export as Lottie + MP4 + GIF. Keep file under 3MB for social.

ava: Brand constraints: use Redwood brand tokens; primary blue #1F3BFF, accent green #00B37E, ink #101316. For dark mode variants invert background but keep contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text. Use Redwood Sans for headings, system for body. Add CSS snippet to figma notes.

design-bot: Reminder: provide AI-check metadata: accessible alt text for images, include source CSV, tag exported files with version and locale codes, run color contrast check. :robot_face:

noah: Localization: please create translated copy layers for JA and DE. I'll supply translations by Tue. For mockups, include placeholder strings: {JA_COPY}, {DE_COPY}. Also include a checklist for translation handoff (fonts, line breaks, truncation rules).

oliver: Legal note — avoid explicit comparative statements like "X% cheaper" until legal signoff. Add a tiny legal layer: "claims pending review".

riley: File structure request: in the figma file please create a top-level page "EXPORTS" that contains final artboards named with tokens like en_US_v1_1200x627.png. Also leave a README frame with usage rules and recommended alt copy.

ava: Timeline: first draft (figma + one export size + Lottie stub) by Wed EOD (1999904588). Finalized kit + localized assets by next Tue.

noah: I'll slot a 20m review with design on Thu to sync.

ava: Shared links: figma proto (will post when available) and gdrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE/bench-launch-assets

oliver: Thanks — excited to get these. :rocket:

design-bot: QA checklist added to figma notes: 1) contrast 4.5, 2) SVG text as outlines only for export copies not masters, 3) Lottie size budget, 4) alt text templates. :white_check_mark:
